subject: SDK changes needed for Quickstart Templates launch (streaming, retries, tracing)
body:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim_khan@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Lo <dana_lo@redwoodinference.com>, Brian Murphy <brian_murphy@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine_wong@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 18, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: SDK changes needed for Quickstart Templates launch (streaming, retries, tracing)

Team — pulling together the SDK deltas we need to land to make the RAG+agent Quickstart Templates “production-minded by default” (and so the template repos don’t end up carrying ugly SDK workarounds).

This is based on the current template implementation plan + the internal beta issues we’ve already hit (streaming disconnects, inconsistent error typing, missing request-id/trace linkage).

Top SDK requirements for template launch (v1):

A) Streaming robustness + typed failures (TS SDK and Python where relevant)
- Ensure streaming surfaces:
  - a stable error type for disconnects (vs generic Error/string)
  - whether the failure is retryable
  - last successfully received event/token count (best-effort)
- Add an opt-in reconnect strategy helper (template will enable by default with capped attempts + jitter)
- Ensure we can differentiate: network reset vs 401/403 vs 429 vs 5xx

B) Retry + timeout defaults aligned with “safe defaults” policy
- Default request timeout(s) (connect + overall) consistent across SDKs
- Retry/backoff policy:
  - retry only safe classes (429, 5xx, network timeouts)
  - exponential backoff w/ jitter
  - respect Retry-After header
  - do NOT retry 4xx (auth/validation)
- The templates will expose overrides via env; SDK should make it easy to plug in without copying code.

C) Tracing + request-id propagation helpers
- Templates must attach Redwood request id into logs and traces.
- Need a simple helper that:
  - extracts x-redwood-request-id (or equivalent) from responses/errors
  - enriches active OTel span attributes
  - makes it easy to add sanitized metadata (model, route, template name/version)

D) Gateway whitelist for template telemetry headers (already in progress)
- The template adoption KPI plan relies on an opt-in header/tag.
- We need to make sure headers don’t cause 4xx behind common proxies; plan is opt-in + short allowlist.

Proposed owner split + timelines (asking you to confirm by EOW):
- TS SDK:
  - Streaming reconnect + better error types: Dana/Ibrahim (target: Feb 28)
  - OTel hooks/middleware: Dana (target: Mar 3)
- Python SDK:
  - Tracing context propagation helpers + request-id capture: Ibrahim (target: Feb 26)
  - Default timeouts/retries alignment: Ibrahim/Brian (target: Feb 28)
- Platform/gateway:
  - Header allowlist: Brian (target: Feb 24)

What I need from each of you:
1) Confirm feasibility of these cut lines for v1.
2) Flag any breaking-change risk or versioning concerns.
3) If any of the above should NOT be in the SDK (and should live in template code), call it out explicitly.

Attachments:
- sdk-gap-summary-quickstart-templates-v1.pdf
- proposed-sdk-cut-lines-and-owners.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica

—
Monica Patel
DevEx Engineering Lead, Quickstarts & SDK Alignment
Redwood Inference


From: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim_khan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Lo <dana_lo@redwoodinference.com>, Brian Murphy <brian_murphy@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine_wong@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 18, 2025 at 11:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: SDK changes needed for Quickstart Templates launch (streaming, retries, tracing)

Makes sense. A couple notes:

- Python:
  - Tracing/request-id helpers are straightforward. We should ship a small “response metadata extractor” that works for both success + error paths.
  - Retry/timeout: aligning defaults is doable but we need to be careful with existing users relying on current retry count. I’d prefer we keep defaults stable but provide a “template recommended policy” builder and have templates set it explicitly.

- TS:
  - Agree error typing is the big gap. Right now streaming failures collapse to generic fetch errors.

- Telemetry headers:
  - +1 on opt-in only. We should also ensure templates work fine with telemetry disabled.

I can start the Python PRs tomorrow. If we keep the default behavior stable and add a helper for templates, timeline is realistic.

Ibrahim


From: Dana Lo <dana_lo@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim_khan@redwoodinference.com>, Brian Murphy <brian_murphy@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine_wong@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 18, 2025 at 1:21 PM PT
Subject: Re: SDK changes needed for Quickstart Templates launch (streaming, retries, tracing)

+1.

TS specifics:
- We can introduce a RedwoodStreamingError with fields:
  - code (network_disconnect, timeout, server_error, auth_error, rate_limited, invalid_request)
  - retryable boolean
  - status (if present)
  - requestId (if present)
- For reconnect:
  - I’d rather provide a small helper (e.g., streamWithReconnect(options)) than bake reconnect into the base client. Templates can enable it by default.
  - We also need to make sure we don’t double-send tool calls on reconnect; we should document “idempotency” expectations for callers.

OTel hooks:
- If we expose middleware hooks around request start/end, templates can attach attributes without monkeypatching fetch.

I’ll sync with Ibrahim later today on the split and open the TS tracking PRs.

Dana


From: Brian Murphy <brian_murphy@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim_khan@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Lo <dana_lo@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine_wong@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 19, 2025 at 9:40 AM PT
Subject: Re: SDK changes needed for Quickstart Templates launch (streaming, retries, tracing)

On gateway header allowlist:
- PR is already in review (internal) to allow a small set of headers through with validation.
- Biggest concern is proxies that reject unknown headers before reaching us.

Proposal:
- Templates default telemetry OFF (no extra headers).
- CLI (or docs) can provide a toggle to enable telemetry headers only when users opt in.

Also: request-id propagation should be consistent — if SDK extracts it, it should populate the error type too.

Brian


From: Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim_khan@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Lo <dana_lo@redwoodinference.com>, Brian Murphy <brian_murphy@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine_wong@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 19, 2025 at 2:18 PM PT
Subject: Re: SDK changes needed for Quickstart Templates launch (streaming, retries, tracing)

Adding a note on tracing helpers:
- Please make sure any helper that auto-adds attributes follows our cardinality rules (no user ids, no full prompts, no tool payloads).
- “requestId”, “model”, “route”, and a boolean like “from_template=true” are fine.
- If we include template name/version, please keep it constrained (e.g., "rag-agent" and semver) and ensure it’s set explicitly rather than deriving from arbitrary strings.

For SDK hooks/middleware: if you can expose a “beforeRequest/afterResponse” hook that accepts a function, templates can attach span attributes without patching the HTTP layer.

Allison


From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim_khan@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Lo <dana_lo@redwoodinference.com>, Brian Murphy <brian_murphy@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine_wong@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 20, 2025 at 4:37 PM PT
Subject: Re: SDK changes needed for Quickstart Templates launch (streaming, retries, tracing)

Thanks all — confirming decisions so we’re aligned:

1) Defaults vs template-recommended builders
- We will NOT change existing SDK default retry counts/timeouts in a way that could surprise current users.
- We WILL ship a “recommended policy” builder in Python + TS (templates will call it explicitly).

2) Streaming reconnect
- We’ll ship helper-level reconnect (opt-in) rather than auto-reconnect in base client.
- Templates will enable with caps (e.g., 2 attempts) and will document non-idempotency caveats.

3) Error typing + request-id
- TS: introduce RedwoodStreamingError (and ensure requestId propagates when present).
- Python: ensure exceptions expose request_id consistently and templates can pull it without parsing strings.

4) Tracing hooks
- TS: middleware hooks for request/response so templates can annotate spans.
- Python: tracing context propagation helper + a safe attribute setter that enforces redaction/cardinality constraints.

5) Telemetry headers
- Telemetry is opt-in by default (no headers unless enabled).
- Brian to continue gateway allowlist PR; we’ll make sure templates don’t break when headers are blocked upstream.

Next step:
- Ibrahim/Dana: please link tracking PRs and update Linear tickets so we can tie to template launch readiness.
- I’ll update the template launch checklist with “SDK builders/hook availability” as explicit gates.

Monica

(Separately, Alex — we should assume we need a 1-week buffer between SDK release and template GA so we can pick up any regressions. I’ll propose dates in the launch brief.)
